correctness.rationale: Dirichlet aggregation and exact beta survival prove the uniform adjacent-gap split and independent rate-two exponential overshoot. Finite acute-event counts are credited to Putnam. Their two-acute conditional mass is 2/(n-2), so finite n ambiguity vanishes. Conditional residual gaps are a scaled Dirichlet vector; maximal gap vanishes exponentially, establishing Hausdorff convergence to a semicircle with one apex. Exact area/perimeter geometry and bounded convergence give the joint limit and means. Checker tests counts and limiting shape on actual packaged file; simulation not used as proof.
